intro R L _ _ _ _
let ad := LieDerivation.ad R L
let range_ad := ad.range
haveI : IsLieAlgebraHom R ad := by apply LieDerivation.isLieAlgebraHom
let ad_map : LieDerivation R L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L := ad
let range_ad_submodule : Submodule R L := ⟨range_ad, by apply Submodule.range⟩
haveI : IsLieSubalgebra R range_ad_submodule := by apply LieDerivation.range_is_LieSubalgebra
let ad_range := range_ad_submodule
let ad_range_ideal := LieIdeal.of_submodule R ad_range
let ad_range_ideal_killing := LieAlgebra.IsKilling.of_killingForm_nondegenerate R ad_range_ideal
exact ad_range_ideal_killing
